$comment: CC BY 4.0 (see REUSE.toml). The personal linking code (blueprint R3, §6.2 linking.code, §6.3; ADR 0016, proposed). Working wording from the blueprint's example ('mother's initials + birth month'); the final recipe comes with the domain lead's survey instruments. maxLength is an input bound, not a model value; the engine's LINKING_CODE_MAX must equal it (packages/engine-py/tests/test_linking_code.py).
title: Your personal linking code
intro: Make a code only you can remake: it links your answers before, after and weeks after the session without your name. Nobody else can read it from the game.
recipe: The initials of your mother's first and last name, then the month you were born as two digits.
example: Mother Ana Bekele, born in March: AB03
presurveyPending: The pre-session survey will appear here once the survey instruments are ready.
